observations.trace: Server input rejects nonfinite movement and quickstep direction, normalizes nonzero direction and requires raised guard plus grounded upright body before begin_authoritative_quickstep installs matching animation and QuickstepPush. The attack lunge path can separately install a push. The clock advances its phase by one sample, uses a minimum one action sample and limits late recovery.
observations.remaining: Other network, restore, NPC, native schedule and player-state paths remain open; client source explicitly does not independently predict only the skeleton for this action.

observations.trace: Startup loads and validates selected combat configuration before installing the runtime snapshot. The motor uses its movement resource; the committed source describes 9.81 gravity, 4.5 reference bodyweights, 9° takeoff, 0.5s quickstep and 64Hz locomotion. Config admission bounds some coefficients and accepts positive finite motor gravity without a shown upper limit.
observations.remaining: No YAML was parsed and no alternate tuning or real action was constructed. Source checks of a single field do not close the aggregate or prove all possible overflow paths.

observations.trace: The motor accounts for biological and carried mass and per-leg health/attributes, and explicitly zeros native Ahoy horizontal acceleration and friction before own force integration. Quickstep tracking and ordinary approach guard zero elapsed; the missing-actuator recovery divides by fixed delta without the same guard.
observations.remaining: No supported paused scheduler plus missing actuator witness is established. The existing 1693 test source has zero initial fixed delta but does not place a quickstep mismatch in the query. Preserve the single general fatigue pool and the intentional physical mass and limb factors.

conditional_findings.first_contract: A fallible quickstep trajectory calculation must not return a nonfinite acceleration alongside an admitted finite speed.
conditional_findings.classification: Original059 Adler finding reassessed on the identical95e helper; no historical unique increment.
conditional_findings.trace: AnimationElapsed accepts finite nonnegative seconds, and quickstep_motion_target admits phase0 and a monotone [0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1] profile. Symbolically with duration1e-25s and target displacement1e-20m, the first derivative at phase0 is zero, so SignedSpeed admits zero; the nonzero acceleration numerator divided by the underflowed duration square yields infinity even though the ideal magnitude is representable. No scalar, duration, config or product function ran.
conditional_findings.safeguards_and_limits: At the stated 64Hz runtime rate the actual sample clock rounds that tiny duration to one action sample and targets phase at least1, so this particular phase0 witness returns early with zero acceleration in the actual motor. Other sample rates, durations, input domains, tracking force and actual scheduling remain open; do not claim normal quickstep produces infinity from this leaf example. The separate force-overflow example has a different first arithmetic boundary.
connected_repair_dependencies: Determine reachable runtime duration, profile, tick, target-distance and native integration domains before choosing a complete calculation or admission owner.
Preserve valid zero/end-phase, action quantization and ordinary finite motion; do not alter the single fatigue pool or physical limb/mass behavior.
Later authorized checks should cover representable acceleration with tiny positive divisors, normal target profiles, end phase and actual supported motor inputs.

conditional_findings.trace: apply_character_motor applies configured controller fields before ordinary speed calculation. After speed succeeds it writes or queues Mass and sets jump height; later quickstep support-duration, trajectory-target or observed-speed rejection logs and continues. The grounded turn-speed rejection occurs later as well. The physics plugin schedules this motor before Ahoy MoveCharacters, so the source exposes an ordering dependency if a rejection occurs; it does not prove an ordinary rejected tick or native solver outcome.
conditional_findings.safeguards_and_limits: The current behavior may deliberately retain partial updates; no whole-step transaction is promised in the inspected source. Input, config and checked speed/duration admissions constrain failure, and native Ahoy behavior, deferred flush points and actual rejected states remain unresolved. The zero-delta partial-restore mismatch branch is a distinct conditional question and the normal paused fixture does not establish it.
connected_repair_dependencies: Establish actual admitted rejection paths and whether previously updated controller/mass settings should be retained or staged atomically with the velocity update.
Trace server/client/restoration paths, plugin scheduling and native Ahoy processing; preserve legitimate initial/generic controller modes and intentional physical mass and limb effects.
Later authorized checks should exercise supported rejection boundaries and ordinary movement without inventing an unobserved paused mismatch.

conditional_findings.severity: unassigned; conditional extreme finite tuning reaches unchecked physical force
conditional_findings.first_contract: An accepted motor configuration and admitted character inputs must produce finite force and velocity or fail at an owning boundary.
conditional_findings.trace: The current aggregate validation requires movement motor gravity to be finite and positive, with no upper bound in its gravity use. Symbolically retain the otherwise valid canonical motor values but use finite gravity1e37 m/s² and biological mass70kg. The multiplication 70×1e37 already exceeds binary32 maximum before the positive bodyweight multiplier, so quickstep_peak_horizontal_force_newtons returns infinity. If an authoritative raised-guard grounded quickstep is accepted and the first supported motor step reaches its ordinary positive force-curve and positive 9° takeoff tangent with finite positive mass and delta, the source multiplies this infinite maximum by the force scale and tangent and adds infinite vertical velocity before Ahoy MoveCharacters. No configuration, YAML, character, force, tick or product ran.
conditional_findings.safeguards_and_limits: This is a deliberately extreme alternative tuning, not the committed 9.81 value or a measured player incident. The full config must otherwise satisfy all validators and be parsed and installed; actual startup, action, support, native timing and floating-point feature behavior were not executed. The finite acceleration helper issue and the motor partial-update observation have distinct first contracts. A finite positive field check alone does not bound the product; do not add arbitrary gameplay restrictions without choosing an owner and physical policy.
connected_repair_dependencies: Choose and document configuration and derived-force admission at the motor authority, including realistic physical bounds or checked complete arithmetic and a typed failure outcome.
Trace all force, traction, gravity, mass and leg-attribute consumers and coordinate any rejection with per-step update policy; retain legitimate encumbrance, limb and single-fatigue behavior.
Later authorized checks should cover ordinary canonical tuning, supported extremes, checked force/velocity and propagation through actual fixed-step consumers.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; source-accepted scalar and conditional overflow chain shown, real configuration/scene, native outcome and exact aliases remain open
